extension.summary: Pokrocily vyhledavac filmu a serialu pro Kodi s integraci Webshare.cz
Advanced movie & TV search for Kodi with Webshare.cz integration
extension.description:
RichMovie je pokrocily vyhledavac filmu a serialu pro Kodi. Nehostuje zadny obsah – pouze hleda dostupne soubory na Webshare.cz podle toho, co tam nekdo z internetu nasdilel.
Hlavni funkce:
• Rychle vyhledavani s metadaty z TMDb (plakaty, popisy, hodnoceni)
• Analyza streamu (MI2) – automaticke rozpoznani kvality, audia a titulku
• Automaticka lokalizace – prednostni vyber ceskeho dabingu a titulku
• Zapamatovani jazykovych preferenci pro kazdy titul zvlast
• Historie sledovani a Pokracovat ve sledovani
• Kolekce – tematicke seznamy filmu (Vanoce, Marvel, Studio Ghibli…)
• Next-Up – automaticke pokracovani na dalsi epizodu serialu
• Integrace RichSubtitles – ceske titulky z Titulky.com
• Trendy a nejlepe hodnocene filmy/serialy
RichMovie je volnocasovy projekt od Richieho – zdarma, pro rodinu a pratele.

RichMovie is an advanced movie and TV search add-on for Kodi. It does not host any content – it only searches for files available on Webshare.cz.
Key features:
• Fast search with TMDb metadata (posters, descriptions, ratings)
• Stream analysis (MI2) – automatic detection of quality, audio and subtitles
• Auto-localization – preferred Czech dubbing and subtitle selection
• Per-title audio/subtitle preference memory
• Watch history and Continue watching
• Collections – curated movie lists (Christmas, Marvel, Studio Ghibli…)
• Next-Up – automatic next episode for TV series
• RichSubtitles integration – Czech subtitles from Titulky.com
• Trending and top-rated movies/TV shows
RichMovie is a hobby project by Richie – free, for family and friends.
extension.changelog:
v3.0.0 – Major architektonicke prepracovani: thin-client. Addon je nyni cista Kodi GUI vrstva, vsechen scraping, MediaInfo probe i TMDb proxy bezi na centralnim NAS Gate (~52 MB ze 129 MB).
• Streaming: BYOC (Bring Your Own Credentials) – soubory jdou primo z Webshare/Fastshare CDN na zarizeni uzivatele, NAS bytes nepretece. • CSFD TV tipy: 3 dny dopredu (dnes/zitra/poprzitri), pre-loaded TMDb metadata (poster, rating, overview, runtime). Klik < 1.5s. • A.I. doporuceni: Claude Opus pres RichClaudeAI tenant (vystridal OpenAI), centralizovany rate limit + telemetrie. • Sdilena crowdsource MediaInfo cache: prvni uzivatel probre stream, ostatni dostanou metadata zdarma. Gate eviduje 700+ unikatnich streamu. • Vyhledavani: vystupy v jedne linii (tabular zarovnani kvality + velikosti), WS/FS prefix u multi-source, MI2 probe blocking 60s pred renderem (zadne raw vystupy). • Fail-fast: zadne legacy scrape fallbacky – zdroje volaji Gate, na chybu cista chybova hlaska. • Spolehlivost: rate limity per uzivatel (search 60/h, probe 300/h), memory limit 1 GB, healthchecky. • Engine: search/filter heuristiky (banned_keys, year_whitelist, ser_title_variants, title_penalty, runtime match) zustavaji v addonu (pul roku ladeni), ale orchestrace pres Gate.
v2.5.1013 – oprava zobrazeni obrazku a popisku v historii serialu; oprava alternativnich stopazi u filmu.
v2.5.1012 – oprava falesneho toastu „preference ulozeny“ pri prehravani.
v2.5.1011 – moznost nacist kolekce na pozadi; lokalni TMDb sken bez blokovaciho dialogu.
v2.5.1009 – stabilita na Androidu (omezeni vlaken, MI2 deduplikace, cache limit).
v2.4.58 – pozadova sluzba service_warm; sjednoceni TMDb cache na 30 dni; denni cache Trendu.
v1.4.0 – Next-Up sluzba; analyza streamu MI2; lokalni pymediainfo.
